name: Pilisborosjenő (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pilisborosjenő (a blue shield with a yellow lion holding a bunch of grapes and a pruning knife) between the names PILISBOROSJENŐ above and Weindorf below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
